changelog:
automation-workflows v1.0.0

- Initial release focused on helping solopreneurs design, build, and maintain no-code automation workflows.
- Step-by-step playbook covering automation opportunity identification, workflow mapping, tool selection (Zapier, Make, n8n), and error handling.
- Includes practical checklists, tool comparisons, and real-world workflow examples.
- Guidance on workflow maintenance, documentation, and troubleshooting common issues.
- Advanced use cases provided, such as onboarding automation and content distribution.
summary: Design and implement automation workflows to save time and scale operations as a solopreneur. Use when identifying repetitive tasks to automate, building workflows across tools, setting up triggers and actions, or optimizing existing automations. Covers automation opportunity identification, workflow design, tool selection (Zapier, Make, n8n), testing, and maintenance. Trigger on "automate", "automation", "workflow automation", "save time", "reduce manual work", "automate my business", "no-code automation".
